login.heading: Sign in
login.connection_lost: Connection to the app was interrupted. Please try again.
empfehlung.heading: Headquarters recommendation
empfehlung.intro: Recommend a markdown stage per model and store, effective from a date. The store accepts or declines with a reason.
konten.heading: Account management
konten.intro: Create and delete staff and store manager accounts.
konten.delete_confirm: Really delete account "{name}"? Past bookings stay in the database.
statistik.heading: Statistics
statistik.intro: Sales by till category, estimated revenue and a reorder suggestion.
statistik.einnahmen_hinweis: Estimate from items marked "sold" and their reduced price at the time – not actual till revenue.
statistik.empfehlung_hinweis: Best-selling articles in this period, next to the current stock.
common.connection_lost: No connection to the app. Please try again.
dashboard.hero_text: Check documents, find articles and trace deliveries.
dashboard.empty: No documents imported yet. Start with “Upload document”.
preview.heading: Review document
preview.intro_line1: Upload a document (invoice, delivery note or order confirmation) and check the detected articles.
preview.intro_line2: The document and its articles are only saved to the database after you confirm.
preview.upload_hint: Up to 20 PDFs / 100 MB total · max. 20 MB and 200 pages per file. Further selections are added to the batch.
preview.batch_hint: Select, review and import documents one at a time. Corrections are kept when switching. Previews not yet imported are discarded when you leave.
preview.ocr_notice: This document was read from a scanned sheet via text recognition (OCR). OCR is not 100% reliable - please check every line especially carefully before importing.
preview.positions_subheading: Search, filter or correct the detected values.
preview.edit_help: Edit fields directly in the table. Existing article master data is kept; corrected values are saved for this document line only.
preview.confirm_label: All lines checked – ready to import.
preview.import_all_hint: The complete document is always imported, even if a filter is active.
preview.errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
preview.errors.duplicate_check_failed: Duplicate check failed. Please read again.
preview.errors.batch_too_large: Maximum 20 files and 100 MB per batch. Please choose a smaller batch.
common.errors.invalid_response: Invalid server response. Please try again.
bestand.heading: Stock
bestand.intro: Current stock per branch. Goods at an external location have no arrival date yet — the storage clock starts once they reach a branch.
bestand.empty: No stock recorded for this selection.
bestand.external_no_date: External location — date set on arrival at a branch
wareneingaenge.heading: Expected deliveries
wareneingaenge.intro: Goods announced by an order confirmation or an order. Stock is only created once you confirm the arrival.
wareneingaenge.arrival_date_hint: Counts towards the storage time. Can be entered retroactively.
wareneingaenge.no_date_for_warehouse: Warehouse without sales: no arrival date — the markdown clock starts at the branch.
wareneingaenge.confirmed_partial: Partial delivery booked — {offen} line(s) remain open.
wareneingaenge.over_delivery: Warning: {anzahl} line(s) arrived in a larger quantity than expected. The actual quantity was booked — please check.
preview.lagerort_not_recognised: No delivery address detected — the active branch applies. Change above if needed.
preview.unsaved_edits: Unsaved corrections. Please check the changes.
preview.read_complete: Reading complete. Please review and confirm each document.
preview.validation_success: Check successful. Please confirm the import again.
preview.import_success: Document {number} saved: {items} lines, {new_products} new articles, {reused_products} existing articles reused.
preview.import_success_batch_pending: Import successful. The batch still has open files or read errors. Please check.
articles.heading: Article search
articles.intro: All articles imported so far, in one place. Search by EAN, brand or description.
articles.hint: Delivered quantities are summed per unit and do not reflect current stock. RRP: most recently recorded value by document date.
articles.status.no_results: No matching articles found. Please adjust the filters.
articles.status.empty: No articles yet. Upload a document under “Upload document” and confirm the import.
articles.errors.connection_lost: No connection to the app. Please search again.
articles.errors.brands_failed: Brands could not be loaded. Please reload the page; quick search stays available.
article_details.stock_hint: All sizes and colours of this article in all branches and warehouses.
article_details.stock_empty: This article is currently not in stock anywhere.
article_details.errors.note_length: Please enter text between 1 and 2000 characters.
article_details.price_status.no_dates: No document date available; prices are shown in the table.
article_details.price_status.empty: No RRP values recorded for this article yet.
article_details.price_status.single: One price recorded – further documents will extend the history.
article_details.price_status.multiple: {count} dated prices. Points show the RRP; connecting lines are for orientation only.
article_details.price_status.undated_suf: Values without a date are shown only in the table.
article_details.chart_aria_label: RRP history in CHF. Exact values are in the table below.
article_details.price_hint: RRP from the documents in CHF, by date. Identical prices within the same document are grouped together.
history.heading: Documents
history.intro: All imported documents with their original line items.
history.delete.label: Enter the document number to delete
history.intro.detail: Every delivery stays visible on its own, even for repeated articles within the same document.
history.invoice_intro: {supplier} · Date {invoice_date} · Document date {document_date} · File: {filename} · Imported by {imported_by}
history.no_raw_text: No original text saved; article data from the master record.
history.connection_lost: Connection to the app was interrupted.

erfassen.heading: Record goods
erfassen.intro: Book goods without a document straight in – scan or type. Only brand, description, quantity and RRP are required.
erfassen.supplier_hint: Optional – helps to find the item again later.
erfassen.kategorie_hint: Optional – only needed for new articles; a category already set stays unchanged.
erfassen.scan_hint: A known EAN fills in the fields. It also works without an EAN.
erfassen.scan_found: Known item: {artikel}. Please check the quantity.
erfassen.scan_unknown: This EAN is not known yet – please fill in the item.
erfassen.invalid_quantity: The quantity must be a number greater than 0.
erfassen.booked: Booked {positionen} position(s) to {lagerort}: {neu} new variant(s), {bekannt} known.
erfassen.booked_no_date: No arrival date – warehouse without sales.
erfassen.book_empty: Please record at least one position first.
erfassen.load_error: Could not load stores and suppliers.
errors.erfassung.no_positions: Please record at least one position.
errors.erfassung.too_many_positions: Too many positions at once (at most {limit}).
errors.erfassung.field_too_long: Line {row}: {field} is too long (at most {limit} characters).
errors.erfassung.invalid_number: Line {row}: {field} is not a valid number.
errors.erfassung.quantity_not_positive: Line {row}: the quantity must be greater than 0.
errors.erfassung.invalid_ean: Line {row}: the EAN must have 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits.
errors.erfassung.ean_missing: Please scan or type an EAN.
errors.erfassung.date_in_future: The arrival date cannot be in the future.
errors.erfassung.integrity_conflict: This EAN was just recorded by someone else. Please try again.
kategorie.heading: Till category
kategorie.load_error: The category could not be loaded.
kategorie.none: No category yet – please choose one.
kategorie.fedas_missing: The document does not contain a FEDAS code.
kategorie.fedas_unknown: FEDAS code {code} is not mapped to a category yet.
kategorie.hint: Applies to every colour and size of this article. Once chosen by hand it stays – no later document overwrites it.
etikett.heading: EAN & label
etikett.load_error: Could not load the EAN and label data.
etikett.ean_none: No EAN yet – cannot be scanned at the till.
etikett.ean_not_printable: No barcode possible – the number is printed as text only.
etikett.generate_hint: Creates an in-house EAN-13 (range 20–29) with check digit – it stays with this variant forever.
etikett.roll_hint: Load the roll with the {farbe} dot (-{prozent}%)
erfassen.print_labels_hint: One label per unit – with year, supplier, RRP and markdown.

errors.ean.already_set: This variant already has the EAN {ean}. An existing EAN is never overwritten.

errors.etikett.too_many: More than {limit} labels at once – please print in several batches.

errors.kategorie.save_failed: The category could not be saved.
ausbuchen.heading: Book out
ausbuchen.intro: Record a sale or other outgoing stock by hand. Each scan books out one piece right away – scan several times for several pieces.
ausbuchen.scan_hint: Items without an EAN can be booked out in the stock view.
ausbuchen.booked_negative: {artikel}: booked out – note: stock was not sufficient. Stock {lagerort}: {menge}
ausbuchen.load_error: The selection lists could not be loaded.
bestand.minus_one_negative: {artikel}: removed – note: stock was not sufficient. Stock {lagerort}: {menge}
errors.ausbuchung.text_required: For “Other”, please describe the reason briefly.
errors.ausbuchung.text_too_long: The reason is too long (at most {max} characters).
errors.ausbuchung.ean_or_variant: Please specify exactly one item: EAN or variant.
errors.ausbuchung.ean_unknown: EAN {ean} is unknown – nothing booked out. Record the item first.
errors.ausbuchung.already_cancelled: This booking has already been undone.
umlagern.heading: Transfer
umlagern.intro: Receive goods from another location. Booked on receipt – removal at the source and addition here in one step.
umlagern.rule_same: Source and destination are the same – please choose two different locations.
umlagern.rule_to_external: Destination without sales: no arrival date – storage time only starts in a branch.
umlagern.rule_from_external: First arrival in a branch: the arrival date is set and storage time starts. Can be backdated.
umlagern.rule_between_branches: Branch to branch: the goods keep their date, storage time here continues. If this branch never had the item, it starts on the arrival date.
umlagern.scan_hint: Each scan adds one piece. Find items without an EAN below in the source's stock.
umlagern.source_short: Note: for {anzahl} item(s) the stock at {quelle} was not sufficient – booked anyway.
errors.umlagerung.same_location: Source and destination are the same.
errors.umlagerung.invalid_quantity: Invalid quantity – please enter a positive number.
bestand.correction_unchanged: {artikel}: stock is already correct ({menge}) – nothing booked.
errors.korrektur.invalid_quantity: Invalid quantity – please enter the counted number of pieces (0 or more).

nav.info.upload: Read an invoice, delivery note or order confirmation

dashboard.no_lagerort: Choose a branch at the top right to see stock, sales and tasks.

dashboard.hinweise.nachlieferung: {artikel}: new delivery received – old stock was reduced {prozent}%. Mark by hand if needed (markdowns).
artikel_loeschen.hint: Only for items entered by mistake: removes the item with all colours, sizes, stock and bookings.
artikel_loeschen.confirm: Really delete “{artikel}” completely? Its stock and bookings are removed too. This cannot be undone.
artikel_loeschen.has_document_hint: This item comes from a document and stays in the master data. Correct the document or delete it.
errors.artikel_loeschen.has_document: This item comes from a document and cannot be deleted – only items entered by hand can be deleted.
errors.artikel_loeschen.failed: The item could not be deleted. Please try again.
reduktion.heading: Mark down
reduktion.intro: Items that have reached −50% or −70% in this branch or will within the next 30 days. Counted from the model's last arrival in this branch.
reduktion.load_error: The list could not be loaded.
reduktion.empty: Nothing to mark down – all up to date.
reduktion.confirmed: {artikel} confirmed – reappears only at the next stage.
reduktion_wahl.heading: Reduction
reduktion_wahl.hint: Recommendation by time in stock, per branch. In your branches you can choose −30, −50 or −70 % by hand; “Recommendation” removes the choice.
reduktion_wahl.save_error: The reduction could not be saved.
reduktion_wahl.pick_hint: Scan the EAN or enter a name – without input the list shows the whole stock of this branch.
reduktion_wahl.pick_none: No article in stock found in this branch.
reduktion_wahl.manual_empty: Nothing is reduced by hand in this branch.
ausbuchen.pick_hint: For articles without EAN or without a scanner: search or browse the whole stock, then “Book out 1 piece”. The reason above applies.
